title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of Ibabang Iyam in the Municipality of Lucena, Province of Quezon
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of Ibabang Iyam in the Municipality of Lucena, Province of Quezon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1779_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The southern portion of the barrio of Iyam in the Municipality of Lucena, Province of Quezon, which is bounded on the north by the provincial road; on the east, by the Iyam River; on the west, by the barrios of Talim and Kanlurang Isabang; and on the south, by the sitio of Pajo, is hereby separated from the said barrio and is created into a new distinct and independent barrio to be known as the barrio of Ibabang Iyam in the same municipality.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
